tokens.name: hd-color-ink
tokens.usage: Identity source. Primary dark canvas and dark text: 18.25:1 on hd-color-paper, 17.0:1 on hd-color-mist, 19.3:1 on hd-color-white. Fixed in both themes; components consume the semantic aliases, never this value.

tokens.name: hd-color-graphite
tokens.usage: Identity source. Raised dark surface under paper, mist or stone text. Never a subtle-on-ink text colour. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-slate
tokens.usage: Identity source. Borders and secondary dark surfaces; as text, on paper (11.83:1), mist or white only. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-stone
tokens.usage: Identity source. Warm structural neutral for large fields and dividers; as text only on ink (12.9:1) or graphite (11.37:1), never small text on paper. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-mist
tokens.usage: Identity source. Soft light surface carrying ink or graphite text; as text on graphite 15.01:1. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-paper
tokens.usage: Identity source. Primary light canvas; as text on ink 18.25:1 and on graphite 16.2:1. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-white
tokens.usage: Identity source. High-contrast text on slate (12.45:1) and the print field. Never an ambient glow or a large luminous field. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-black
tokens.usage: Identity source (identity board). The field of the reverse lockup only: one white ink on black. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-muted-slate
tokens.usage: Identity source (declared contrast pairing). Muted text on hd-color-paper at 4.52:1: normal text at tested sizes only, never thin or small metadata. On mist it drops to 4.2:1, so keep it on paper. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-cyan-on-dark
tokens.usage: Identity source. Primary action, active connection and current path on ink (10.86:1) or graphite (9.58:1). Never on paper, mist or white: use hd-color-signal-cyan-on-light there. Text on a cyan fill is ink. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-cyan-on-light
tokens.usage: Identity source. Cyan for text, focus, icons and lines on paper (5.68:1), mist (5.29:1) and white; paper text on it reads at 5.70:1. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-amber-on-dark
tokens.usage: Identity source. Attention and conditional state on ink (10.49:1) or graphite (9.26:1); ink text on an amber fill 10.49:1. Never inferred as destructive. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-amber-on-light
tokens.usage: Identity source. Amber text, icons and conditional graphics on paper (5.85:1) and mist (5.45:1). Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-lime-on-dark
tokens.usage: Identity source. Verified state and data series on ink (14.66:1) or graphite (12.9:1). Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-lime-on-light
tokens.usage: Identity source. Verified text and graphics on paper (4.66:1) and white. On mist it falls to about 4.3:1, below the 4.5:1 floor: keep verified text on paper. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-violet-on-dark
tokens.usage: Identity source. Demonstration state and spatial resonance on ink (7.21:1) or graphite (6.4:1). Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-color-signal-violet-on-light
tokens.usage: Identity source. Demonstration text and graphics on paper (5.66:1) and mist (5.27:1). Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: hd-surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page canvas: the identity board's paper page, ink in the dark theme. Proposed alias (the source leaves semantic surfaces unresolved); text on it is hd-text-primary.

tokens.name: hd-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and application blocks on the canvas. Text on it: hd-text-primary (17.0:1 light, 16.2:1 dark) or hd-text-secondary.

tokens.name: hd-surface-recessed
tokens.usage: Large structural fields and dividers behind content. Never small text on it; ink or paper text only, at heading sizes.

tokens.name: hd-surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A dark section inside a light page (masthead, hero, recommended card) and the reverse in dark. Text on it: hd-text-inverse; signals on it: the hd-signal-*-on-inverse tokens.

tokens.name: hd-surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: A raised panel on hd-surface-inverse, and the notice block on the canvas (the identity board's clearance notice: graphite with an amber rule). Text on it: hd-text-inverse.

tokens.name: hd-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on hd-surface-canvas (18.25:1 both themes) and hd-surface-raised (17.0:1 light, 16.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: hd-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, card titles and pattern notes on the canvas and raised surfaces: 11.83:1 light on paper; 12.9:1 dark on ink, 11.37:1 on graphite.

tokens.name: hd-text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata at 16px or larger on hd-surface-canvas only: 4.52:1 light, 12.9:1 dark. Never thin, small, or the sole location of a limitation.

tokens.name: hd-text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on hd-surface-inverse and hd-surface-inverse-raised: 18.25:1 and 16.2:1 light; 18.25:1 and 17.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-text-muted-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Ledes, footers and card titles on hd-surface-inverse: 12.9:1 light; 4.52:1 dark at 16px or larger only.

tokens.name: hd-text-on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on any on-dark signal fill (cyan, amber, lime, violet): always ink, 10.49:1 or better in both themes. White on a signal fill is prohibited.

tokens.name: hd-text-signal
tokens.usage: Cyan as text on the canvas and raised surfaces: eyebrows, active labels, the current path. 5.29:1 or better light; 9.58:1 or better dark.

tokens.name: hd-text-link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of hd-text-signal so a theme that moves cyan moves links. Underline on hover with a 0.2em offset; weight 700 in navigation.

tokens.name: hd-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px hairlines: card and figure edges, footer rule. Below 3:1 by design, so never the only boundary of a control or a meaningful region.

tokens.name: hd-border-strong
tokens.usage: Meaningful boundaries at 3:1 or better: inputs, secondary buttons, dividers that carry structure. 11.83:1 light on paper; 12.9:1 dark on ink.

tokens.name: hd-border-interactive
tokens.usage: Active or selected boundary on the canvas and raised surfaces: 5.68:1 light, 10.86:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 3px solid outline (hd-focus-ring-width) offset 4px (hd-focus-offset) on every focusable element. 5.68:1 on paper and 3.22:1 on ink in the light theme; 10.86:1 on ink in the dark theme. Never clipped, never animated across the viewport.

tokens.name: hd-signal-cyan-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Cyan on hd-surface-inverse: the 6px accent rule of a hero block, the recommended card's 3px frame, the primary action inside a hero, the relay in the lockup. 10.86:1 light; 5.68:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-signal-amber-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Amber on hd-surface-inverse and hd-surface-inverse-raised: the notice's 4px rule, attention text inside a hero. 9.26:1 light on graphite; 5.45:1 dark on mist.

tokens.name: hd-signal-lime-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Verified state markers and data series on hd-surface-inverse: 14.66:1 light on ink; 4.66:1 dark on paper.

tokens.name: hd-signal-violet-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Demonstration state markers and data series on hd-surface-inverse: 7.21:1 light on ink; 5.66:1 dark on paper.

tokens.name: hd-action-primary-background
tokens.usage: Primary action fill on the canvas (Book, the one conversion action per surface). Proposed alias: the identity board's cyan Book action, moved to the on-light cyan on paper. Inside hd-surface-inverse use hd-signal-cyan-on-inverse with hd-text-primary.

tokens.name: hd-action-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on hd-action-primary-background: 5.70:1 light, 10.86:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-action-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary action label on a transparent fill with hd-action-secondary-border. Inside hd-surface-inverse the label is hd-text-inverse and the border hd-text-muted-on-inverse.

tokens.name: hd-action-secondary-border
tokens.usage: The 1px border of a secondary action; also the border of a disabled action, whose fill is hd-surface-raised and label hd-text-secondary so it stays readable.

tokens.name: hd-status-verified
tokens.usage: Verified evidence state: filled circle marker plus solid rail, label Verified with source and date. Only when the evidence and publication gates are satisfied. Light: on paper only (4.66:1); dark: 14.66:1 on ink.

tokens.name: hd-status-demo
tokens.usage: Hengshi-owned capability demonstration: open diamond marker plus dash-dot rail (10 4 2 4), label Hengshi-owned capability demonstration. 5.66:1 light; 7.21:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-status-proposed
tokens.usage: Proposed method or requirement: filled square marker plus short-dash rail (8 6), label Proposed or Requirement. 5.68:1 light; 10.86:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-status-attention
tokens.usage: Review needed or conditional: filled triangle marker plus long-dash rail (16 7), label Review needed or the exact condition. Amber is attention, never destructive. 5.85:1 light; 10.49:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-status-held
tokens.usage: Unavailable or held: neutral filled bar marker plus dotted rail (2 7), label Unavailable or Held with the next useful route. 11.83:1 light; 12.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: hd-status-error
tokens.usage: Error: an amber boundary (open octagon marker, two parallel solid rails) around neutral content, with a plain-language message and a recovery action. Never colour alone.

tokens.name: hd-status-attention-fill
tokens.usage: Solid attention fill for the Recommended tag, with hd-text-on-signal (ink) on it: 10.49:1 in both themes. Small labels only; never a large field.

tokens.name: hd-data-series-context-baseline
tokens.usage: Illustrative data series Context baseline: plus marker, custom dash 1 5 9 5, direct-labelled at the line end. Never an evidence status.

tokens.name: hd-data-series-dependency-map
tokens.usage: Illustrative data series Dependency map: ring marker, custom dash 12 3 3 3 3 3, direct-labelled. Never an evidence status.

tokens.name: hd-data-series-decision-frame
tokens.usage: Illustrative data series Decision frame: cross marker, solid line, direct-labelled. Never an evidence status.

tokens.name: hd-data-series-evidence-depth
tokens.usage: Illustrative data series Evidence depth: hexagon marker, even dash 5 5, direct-labelled; on paper in the light theme. Never an evidence status.

tokens.name: hd-data-series-risk-view
tokens.usage: Illustrative data series Risk view: X marker, custom dash 13 4 4 4, direct-labelled. Never an evidence status.

families.evidence: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "Segoe UI Mono", Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Entity, promise and decisive headings. The source gives a 40 to 72px range at weight 650 (700 fallback), leading 0.95 to 1.05, tracking -0.025em; the identity board runs its masthead fluidly from 48 to 120px. Platform system fonts only: no file is shipped.

styles.name: hd-display-1
styles.usage: The entity name and the promise at masthead scale: the top of the display range. Weight 650 where the platform face has it; the board tightens tracking to -0.06em at this size.

styles.name: hd-display-2
styles.sample: From complex ambition to accountable delivery.
styles.usage: Section headings, at most 18 characters per line; the board h2 runs fluidly 35 to 76px with -0.045em tracking.

styles.name: hd-display-3
styles.usage: Decisive headings at the bottom of the display range: panel, hero-sample and detail titles.

styles.name: hd-promise
styles.sample: From complex ambition to accountable delivery.
styles.usage: The promise statement (the board .promise: 650 weight, 32 to 64px fluid, -0.04em). One per page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body, navigation, forms and explanations. 16px is the body default; nothing meaningful below 12px; 45 to 75 characters per line.

styles.name: hd-heading
styles.usage: Card, figure and subsection titles (the board h3, 20 to 32px fluid). Sentence case.

styles.name: hd-lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under a display heading; hd-text-muted-on-inverse when on a masthead. The top of the 16 to 20px text range.

styles.name: hd-body
styles.sample: The identity must remain understandable when all animation, imagery, sound, WebGL and colour are removed.
styles.usage: Running text, navigation, form copy and explanations in hd-text-primary. The default size for every surface.

styles.name: hd-body-strong
styles.sample: Quick Access is not a lower-quality brand mode.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text and definition terms; the upper weight of the 400 to 500 text range.

styles.name: hd-action
styles.usage: Button labels, the Recommended tag and navigation links (the board sets actions and tags at 800, navigation at 700). Sentence case; never all caps.

groups.name: Evidence and meta
groups.note: Monospace for evidence state, version, date, source and measurement: 12 to 14px, weight 500 to 600, leading 1.4 to 1.6. Supplemental, never the sole location of a limitation or an essential instruction.

styles.name: hd-eyebrow
styles.usage: The one uppercase style: a category or section eyebrow in hd-text-signal above a display heading. Set text-transform uppercase in the consumer.

styles.name: hd-evidence
styles.usage: Evidence-state labels, source and review dates beside content; the text of the EvidenceStateLabel component.

styles.name: hd-meta
styles.usage: Version, checksum, measurement and code samples in hd-text-secondary; figure captions.

styles.name: hd-series-key
styles.usage: The marker-and-pattern key of a directly labelled data series (the board .series-key); the DataSeriesKey component.

spacing.note: The unit is 4px; the source scale has nine steps and the reserved code names hd-space-1 to hd-space-9 map to them one to one.

tokens.name: hd-space-1
tokens.usage: Marker gaps, the focus-ring offset, hairline insets.

tokens.name: hd-space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps between a marker and its label, tag padding, gaps inside a button.

tokens.name: hd-space-3
tokens.usage: Chip and swatch padding, gaps inside compact lists.

tokens.name: hd-space-4
tokens.usage: Card, notice and access-tile padding; navigation gaps; the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: hd-space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards and figures; clearspace around a 32px mark.

tokens.name: hd-space-6
tokens.usage: Margin under a section heading and above an action row; the section padding floor at narrow widths.

tokens.name: hd-space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a specimen figure inside a section; large gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: hd-space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding at medium widths; vertical rhythm between major blocks.

tokens.name: hd-space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on wide screens (the board pads sections from 32px to 96px fluidly).

radius.note: A square system: the evidence-frame range is 0 to 4px and the identity board renders 0. Controls take 8px; pills are for short visible-text labels only. Never round the logo brackets.

tokens.name: hd-radius-none
tokens.usage: Evidence frames, cards, notices, figures, logo fields and tags: the board choice within the accepted 0 to 4px range.

tokens.name: hd-radius-evidence-frame
tokens.usage: The upper bound of the accepted evidence-frame range; use only when a frame must soften, never on the logo or a status marker.

tokens.name: hd-radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects and other controls (the identity token control radius).

tokens.name: hd-radius-status
tokens.usage: Pill status labels only: short labels with visible text. Not for cards, images or frames.

stroke.note: Strokes are square-capped and mitred, from the 6-unit logo frame down to the 2-unit icon base. Signal strokes run 2 to 5px by output size and never fall below 2 device pixels.

tokens.name: hd-stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Card, figure and swatch borders in hd-border-subtle or hd-border-strong.

tokens.name: hd-icon-stroke
tokens.usage: The icon base stroke on the 24-unit grid; also the open evidence markers (diamond, octagon).

tokens.name: hd-icon-grid
tokens.usage: Icon grid in units; 20 CSS px minimum on screen, 24 CSS px for controls.

tokens.name: hd-signal-stroke-min
tokens.usage: Thinnest signal rail or path, at small output sizes.

tokens.name: hd-signal-stroke-max
tokens.usage: Thickest signal rail, matching the logo relay at master scale.

tokens.name: hd-min-device-stroke
tokens.usage: Device pixels: the floor for any retained stroke at small mark sizes (the 24 and 16px optical marks are built to it).

tokens.name: hd-stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The recommended card frame width; the same width as the focus ring.

tokens.name: hd-focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Width of the keyboard focus outline in hd-focus-ring.

tokens.name: hd-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Outline offset of the focus ring, so the ring never clips into the control.

tokens.name: hd-stroke-notice-rule
tokens.usage: The left rule of a notice in hd-signal-amber-on-inverse.

tokens.name: hd-stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Accent rule on a hero or evidence block (top or left) in hd-signal-cyan-on-inverse; the masthead bottom rule is 8px.

layout.note: Twelve columns wide, six medium, four narrow; collapse follows content need, and visual asymmetry never changes semantic reading order.

tokens.name: hd-grid-columns-wide
tokens.usage: Column count on wide screens.

tokens.name: hd-grid-columns-medium
tokens.usage: Column count at medium widths (the board collapses three-up grids at 880px).

tokens.name: hd-grid-columns-narrow
tokens.usage: Column count at narrow widths (the board goes to one column at 520px).

tokens.name: hd-content-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width; gutters grow beyond it.

tokens.name: hd-measure-max
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for headings and paragraphs; sustained reading sits at 45 to 75 characters.

tokens.name: hd-viewport-min
tokens.usage: Every layout reflows here without horizontal loss, at 400% zoom and with increased text spacing.

tokens.name: hd-target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target, 24 by 24 CSS px, or a documented exception.
